airspace.zh: 斯里蘭卡民航局（CAASL）規定：無人機須登記；除250公克以下、無相機、在自有土地150呎以下的飛行外，任何飛行都要事先取得CAASL核准與安全許可並投保，限高150呎。實際飛行前請向CAASL申請。
airspace.en: Sri Lanka's civil aviation authority (CAASL) requires drones to be registered; except tiny camera-less drones on one's own land below 150 ft, every flight needs prior CAASL approval, a security clearance and insurance, with a 150 ft height limit. Apply to the CAASL before flying.

pidurangala.note: cave temple on Pidurangala Rock, about 1 km north

minneriya.note: national park around an ancient tank (Wikidata Q15253488)

angammedilla.note: national park east of Sigiriya (Wikidata Q4761937)

title.zh-Hant: 迦葉波國王的天空之城
title.en: King Kashyapa's City in the Sky

tagline.zh-Hant: 五世紀的十八年王都，與之後八百年的寺院
tagline.en: A capital for eighteen years in the fifth century, then a monastery for centuries

zh: 斯里蘭卡中部的平原上，
一塊巨岩陡然拔起。
en: On the plain of central Sri Lanka
a great rock rises abruptly.

zh: 這是錫吉里亞，
迦葉波一世在西元477到495年間的王都。
en: This is Sigiriya,
the capital of King Kashyapa I from 477 to 495.

zh: 他從父親達都斯那手中奪下王位，
把首都從阿努拉德普勒遷到這裡。
en: He seized the throne from his father, Dhatusena,
and moved the capital here from Anuradhapura.

zh: 這裡同時是要塞，
也是一座宮苑。
en: It was both a fortress
and a pleasure palace.

zh: 原本在岩上修行的僧人，
被請到北邊的皮杜蘭加拉。
en: The monks who lived at the rock
were asked to move to Pidurangala, to the north.

zh: 迦葉波整修了那裡的寺院，作為補償。
en: Kashyapa refurbished the temple there in compensation.

zh: 皮杜蘭加拉寺的歷史，
可能早到西元前一、二世紀。
en: The history of the Pidurangala temple
may reach back to the first or second century BC.

zh: 依《大史》記載，他的兄弟目犍連帶兵歸來，
迦葉波兵敗身亡。
en: According to the Mahavamsa, his brother Moggallana returned with an army
and Kashyapa was defeated and died.

zh: 首都遷回阿努拉德普勒，
錫吉里亞改成佛教寺院。
en: The capital returned to Anuradhapura,
and Sigiriya became a Buddhist monastery.

zh: 寺院一直延續到
十三、十四世紀。
en: The monastery lasted
until the thirteenth or fourteenth century.

zh: 1831年，福布斯少校騎馬路過，
看見了長滿灌木的岩頂。
en: In 1831 Major Jonathan Forbes, riding past,
saw the brushwood-covered summit.

zh: 1890年代開始小規模考古，
1982年起文化三角計畫全面整理。
en: Small excavations began in the 1890s;
from 1982 the Cultural Triangle Project studied the whole city.

zh: 1982年，錫吉里亞古城列入世界遺產。
en: In 1982 the Ancient City of Sigiriya was inscribed as World Heritage.

zh: 十八年的王都，幾百年的寺院，
都留在這塊巨岩上。
en: Eighteen years as a capital and centuries as a monastery
are all written on this rock.

title.en: Lion's Paws, Frescoes and the Mirror Wall

tagline.zh-Hant: 岩壁上的畫，與一千多年前遊客留下的詩
tagline.en: Paintings on the rock, and poems left by visitors more than a thousand years ago

zh: 岩石半腰有一處小平台，
曾立著一座巨大的獅子形城門。
en: Halfway up the rock is a small plateau
where a gateway in the form of a huge lion once stood.

zh: 獅頭已經崩落，
只剩下兩隻巨大的獅爪。
en: The lion's head has collapsed;
only its two great paws remain.

zh: 「錫吉里亞」這個名字，
就來自這座獅子門。
en: The name Sigiriya
comes from this lion gateway.

zh: 岩石西面，曾畫滿壁畫，
範圍約長一百四十公尺、高四十公尺。
en: The western face was once covered in paintings,
an area about 140 metres long and 40 metres high.

zh: 古代的塗鴉提到「五百位仕女」，
但大部分畫作已經消失。
en: Ancient graffiti speak of "500 ladies",
but most of the paintings have been lost.

zh: 1967年，壁畫曾遭人潑漆，
修復到1968年4月才完成。
en: In 1967 paint was splashed on the frescoes;
restoration lasted until April 1968.

zh: 岩壁上還有一段鏡牆，
當年磨得光亮，國王能看見自己的倒影。
en: The rock also has the Mirror Wall,
once so polished the king could see himself in it.

zh: 八世紀起，遊客在牆上寫下詩句，
大多來自九、十世紀。
en: From the eighth century visitors wrote verses on the wall,
most of them in the ninth and tenth centuries.

zh: 學者帕拉納維塔納解讀了六百八十五首，
牆上的詩總共超過一千五百首。
en: The scholar Paranavithana deciphered 685 verses;
in all there are more than 1,500 poems.

zh: 為了保護古代的字跡，
現在禁止在牆上再寫任何東西。
en: To protect the old writing,
nothing may be written on the wall today.

zh: 往西南直線約十七公里，是丹布勒石窟寺。
en: About seventeen kilometres to the south-west is the Dambulla cave temple.

zh: 五座主要石窟裡，
有一百五十三尊佛像。
en: Its five main caves
hold 153 statues of the Buddha.

zh: 石窟裡的壁畫，
總面積約兩千一百平方公尺。
en: The murals inside
cover about 2,100 square metres.

zh: 國王的畫、遊客的詩、僧人的石窟，
一起寫成這一帶的歷史。
en: A king's paintings, visitors' poems and monks' caves
together tell the history of this land.

tagline.zh-Hant: 古代的水景花園，與附近國家公園裡的乾季象群
tagline.en: Ancient water gardens, and the dry-season elephants of a nearby park

zh: 巨岩腳下，古代的花園與護城河向外延伸幾百公尺。
en: At the foot of the rock ancient gardens and moats reach out a few hundred metres.

zh: 水景花園沿著東西向的軸線，
對稱地排列。
en: The water gardens are laid out
symmetrically along an east–west axis.

zh: 池塘、小島，與圓形的石灰岩板噴泉，
有些到雨季還會噴水。
en: Pools, islands and fountains of round limestone plates;
some still work in the rainy season.

zh: 巨石花園裡，大石頭之間有小路相連，
石頭上曾建有亭閣。
en: In the boulder gardens, winding paths link great boulders
that once carried pavilions.

zh: 梯田花園用磚牆圍出一層層平台，
大致環繞著巨岩。
en: Terraced gardens with brick walls
ring the rock in rough circles.

zh: 登岩的步道上有告示，
請遊客保持安靜，以免驚動胡蜂。
en: Signs along the climb ask visitors to keep quiet
so as not to provoke the wasps.

zh: 往東約十公里，
是明內里耶國家公園。
en: About ten kilometres east
is Minneriya National Park.

zh: 公園裡的明內里耶水庫，
由摩訶舍那王在西元286年修築。
en: The park's Minneriya tank
was built by King Mahasen in AD 286.

zh: 水壩高十三公尺、長兩公里，
集水區兩百四十九平方公里。
en: The dam is 13 metres high and 2 kilometres long,
with a catchment of 249 square kilometres.

zh: 每年八、九月乾旱最嚴重時，
傍晚可聚集約五百頭野象。
en: In August and September, at the height of the drought,
some 500 wild elephants gather here in the evening.

zh: 公園記錄到二十四種哺乳類、
一百六十種鳥類。
en: The park records 24 species of mammals
and 160 species of birds.

zh: 這裡屬於乾燥區，年雨量一千五百到兩千毫米，
四到十月是乾季。
en: It lies in the dry zone, with 1,500 to 2,000 mm of rain a year
and a dry season from April to October.

zh: 回到錫吉里亞，
花園的水池仍承接著雨季的水。
en: Back at Sigiriya,
the garden pools still take in the rains.

zh: 一千七百多年前的水庫，
至今仍是乾季象群聚集的地方。
en: A tank built more than 1,700 years ago
is still where the elephants gather in the dry season.

title.en: A Lone Rock on the Plain

tagline.zh-Hant: 殘丘地形、岩頂的城塞，與周圍的岩石與水庫
tagline.en: An inselberg, the citadel on its summit, and the rocks and tanks around it

zh: 錫吉里亞是一座孤立的殘丘，
從平原上陡然升起。
en: Sigiriya is an inselberg,
a lone rock rising abruptly from the plain.

zh: 它高出周圍平原近兩百公尺。
en: It stands nearly 200 metres above the surrounding plain.

zh: 築有城牆的城塞，
面積約十五公頃。
en: The walled citadel
covers about 15 hectares.

zh: 上山的路，經過半腰的獅子門平台。
en: The way up passes the lion-gate plateau halfway up.

zh: 穿過花園再登上岩頂，
大約要一個半小時。
en: Walking through the gardens and climbing to the top
takes about an hour and a half.

zh: 北邊約一公里，
是另一座巨岩皮杜蘭加拉。
en: About one kilometre north
is another great rock, Pidurangala.

zh: 兩座岩石都從低平的平原上突起。
en: Both rocks rise abruptly from the low-lying plain.

zh: 岩下的洞窟裡，有一尊用磚砌成的巨大臥佛。
en: In its caves lies a monumental brick statue of the reclining Buddha.

zh: 往西南，丹布勒的岩石
高出平原一百六十公尺。
en: To the south-west, the rock of Dambulla
rises 160 metres above the plains.

zh: 丹布勒石窟寺的歷史，
可追溯到西元前一世紀。
en: The Dambulla cave temple
dates back to the first century BC.

zh: 往東，經過錫吉里亞，
是明內里耶與安加梅迪拉兩座國家公園。
en: Eastwards, past Sigiriya,
lie two national parks, Minneriya and Angammedilla.

zh: 明內里耶水庫，
在乾燥區裡蓄起一大片水面。
en: The Minneriya tank
holds a broad sheet of water in the dry zone.

zh: 從空中看，巨岩、森林與水庫交錯成這片地景。
en: From the air, rock, forest and tanks make up this landscape.

zh: 一塊孤岩，讓國王選它當作王都。
en: A single rock on the plain was what a king chose for his capital.
